Container.Name: HomeWeb
Container.Overview: Your own Apache and PHP 8.5 web server. One website per container, with a clean starter page and live component versions. Add databases separately. For another website, use a different container name, host port, website folder and configuration folder.
Container.Description: Host HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP with .htaccess, URL rewriting, sessions and uploads. PHP supports MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Web requests run as PUID/PGID; initialization uses root. Existing website files and their ownership are preserved. Optional /config/php.ini is trusted administrator configuration, applied on restart. Install updates through Unraid. Configure internet access and HTTPS separately.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Choose a free host port for each website.

Config.Name: Website files
Config.Description: Use a separate folder for each website. Only a completely empty folder receives the starter page.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Separate configuration folder for each website; stores optional php.ini and initialization state.

Config.Name: PHP memory limit
Config.Description: Positive size in M or G; must cover the upload limit plus overhead.

Config.Name: Upload limit
Config.Description: Maximum size per file. post_max_size includes extra multipart overhead.
